t: 先看来源，再看证据。想清楚，再下结论。

gestures.action: lifts her right forearm and opens her right palm upward at waist level, with a small shoulder weight shift
opens her left palm in a contrasting explanatory gesture while relaxing the right hand
briefly pauses her hands and gives one small thoughtful nod
makes one gentle downward beat with her right open palm on the stressed final words, then rests both hands naturally near the waist
